results.name: Cable Reverse Grip Straight Back Seated High Row
instructions: Sit at the pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Attach a straight bar to the high pulley and grasp the bar with both hands using an underhand grip (palms facing back), hands shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your back straight and arms fully extended above your head.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest by bending your elbows and bringing them down and back, keeping your upper arms close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid leaning back or using momentum.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the bottom of the movement.
Exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you extend it back up.
results.description: Cable Reverse Grip Straight Back Seated High Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Seated One Arm Alternate Row
instructions: Sit on the seated cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and knees slightly bent. Attach a single handle to the low pulley and grasp the handle with your right hand, arm fully extended towards the machine.
Sit upright with your back straight, keeping your left hand on your left knee for support.
Pull the handle towards your lower abdomen by bending your elbow and bringing it back, keeping your upper arm close to your body.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left hand.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Exhale as you pull the handle towards your body and inhale as you extend it back.
results.description: Cable Seated One Arm Alternate Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the seated pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor. Attach a V-bar handle to the low pulley and grasp the handle with both hands, palms facing each other.
Sit upright with your back straight and arms fully extended towards the machine.
Pull the handle towards your lower abdomen by bending your elbows and bringing them backwards, keeping your upper arms close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you pull the handle towards your body and inhale as you extend it back.
Avoid rounding your back; keep your chest lifted throughout the exercise.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
results.description: Cable Seated Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Seated Supine Grip Row
instructions: Sit on the seated pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor. Attach a straight bar to the middle pulley and grasp the bar with both hands using a supine grip (palms facing up), hands shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your back straight and arms fully extended towards the machine.
Pull the bar towards your lower abdomen by bending your elbows and bringing them back, keeping your upper arms close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you pull the bar towards your body and inhale as you extend it back.
Avoid rounding your back; keep your chest lifted throughout the exercise.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
results.description: Cable Seated Supine Grip Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Seated on Floor Row
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a cable machine with your legs extended straight out in front of you. Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and grasp the bar with both hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing down.
Sit upright with your back straight and arms fully extended towards the machine. Bend your knees slightly for comfort.
Pull the handle towards your lower abdomen by bending your elbows and bringing them backwards, keeping your upper arms close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Exhale as you pull the bar towards your body and inhale as you extend it back.
results.description: Cable Seated on Floor Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Biceps, Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Silverback Shrug
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley while holding a straight bar with both hands at shoulder width apart, using an overhand grip. Hinge slightly at your hips and keep your arms fully extended.
Elevate your shoulders toward your ears while keeping your elbows straight and your torso still.
Pause briefly at the top while squeezing your upper back muscles.
Lower your shoulders slowly to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended throughout the exercise.
Maintain a slight hip hinge and a neutral spine throughout the movement.
Squeeze your upper trapezius at the top of each repetition.
Inhale as you lower your shoulders and exhale as you shrug upward.
results.description: Cable Silverback Shrug is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with a straight bar attached to the high pulley. Grasp the bar with both hands, palms facing down, and place your hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, lean your torso slightly forward and keep your back straight and a slight bend in your knees. Extend your arms fully in front of you at shoulder height.
Pull the bar down towards your thighs, keeping your arms straight throughout the movement.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position with control, bringing it back to shoulder height. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms straight throughout the exercise to target the middle back muscles.
Focus on engaging your lats and core during the movement.
Exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Triceps.

results.name: Cable Twin Handle Parallel Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit upright on a bench positioned between two cable pulley machines with the pulleys set at a high position. Hold a handle in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), arms fully extended above you.
Pull the handles down towards your shoulders by bending your elbows and bringing them downwards, keeping them close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the bottom of the movement.
Exhale as you pull the handles down and inhale as you extend them back up.
results.description: Cable Twin Handle Parallel Grip Lat Pulldown is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Twisting Pull
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with the left foot forward and the right foot back, knees bent. Attach a handle to the low pulley and grasp it with the right hand, palm facing down. Lean forward so your upper body is almost parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm fully towards the pulley, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handle towards your torso, rotating your wrist as you pull until your palm faces the ceiling.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Exhale as you pull the handle towards your torso and inhale as you extend it back.
Keep your feet firmly planted on the floor for stability.
Keep your core tight throughout the exercise to protect your lower back.
results.description: Cable Twisting Pull is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Shoulders, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Underhand Pulldown Wide Grips
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Attach a wide grip bar to the high pulley and grasp it with both hands using an underhand grip (palms facing back), hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest by bending your elbows and bringing them down and back.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the bottom of the movement.
Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid flaring them out.
Exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you extend it back up.
results.description: Cable Underhand Pulldown Wide Grips is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Shoulders.
